newsitem.title: USA: Finish Line to open 50 to 60 new stores.
newsitem.headline: Finish Line to open 50 to 60 new stores.

text.p: Finish Line Inc, which earlier reported higher earnings for the first quarter, said Monday it expected to open 50 to 60 new stores and enter six new states this year.
The athletic goods retailer said it opened 15 stores in the first quarter and planned to launch another 15 in the second quarter.

The company planned to enter six new states this year: New Jersey, New Hampshire, Connecticut, Massachusetts, Arizona and Washington. In addition to new stores, the company expected to remodel or expand 15 to 18 existing units this year.
Earlier Finish Line said it earned $4.5 million, or $0.17 a share, compared to $3.2 million, or $0.15 a share, in the first quarter of last year. Sales rose to $87.5 million from $71.7 million.

"We are pleased to report a 41 percent increase in net earnings for the quarter, with inventory, on a per square foot basis, substantially under last year levels," said Finish Line President and Chief Executive Alan Cohen in a statement.

Finish Line adjusted its accounting calendar to conform with one more commonly used in the industry in the fourth quarter of last year. Because of this change, sales for the period ended May 31 included one less day than the calendar quarter reported for last year.

The company recorded interest income of $722,000 versus $194,000 of interest expense a year ago. The income was the result of two secondary public offerings, through which Finish Line raised $84.0 million. The company used the proceeds to pay down debt and to cover new and remodeled store openings. It invested the rest in interest bearing instruments.
